Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for the call today — really appreciate the clear context on the priority use cases and timeline. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

1) Decision criteria: you mentioned top priorities are (a) latency guarantees for customer-facing features, (b) data isolation / VPC support, and (c) predictable per-token unit economics.
2) Key stakeholders we captured: you (product), Priya (procurement), and the legal/security reviewer (still TBD).
3) Timeline: target pilot kickoff narrow window: mid-August; procurement + security review by end of July.

Proposed immediate actions:
- I will share a short SOC 2 summary + our data handling overview for your security reviewer (attaching SOC2 summary).
- Can Priya share the current procurement questionnaire or preferred contract template?
- If helpful, Rishi (our AE lead) can join a procurement/contract sync next week to walk through SLAs and pricing.

Attachments: redwood_soc2_summary.pdf (one-pager), mutual_action_plan_finovate.xlsx (draft M A P with owners).

Next call: suggest 30 minutes next Wed to align on procurement questions and confirm legal reviewer — does 10am PT work for you?

Thanks —
Marissa

Great — attaching the SOC 2 summary now (redwood_soc2_summary.pdf). I can share the full Type II report under an NDA; happy to coordinate a secure upload. Answers to your quick questions:

- BYO KMS: supported via KMS integrations (AWS KMS, GCP KMS); we can provide the integration pattern for your security team.

Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2026 09:16:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stakeholder mapping & next steps — procurement + legal checkpoints

Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks for the context, and happy to join the Wed session — adding a couple quick enablement bullets so you have them ahead of the call:

1) Pricing options (ballpark for pilot: 1–2M tokens/month)
   - On-demand: $0.0008 / input token; $0.0020 / output token (no commit)
   - Reserved monthly commit (recommended for pilot to control unit economics): starting at 1M committed tokens/month reduces output token price to $0.0016; includes 99.9% uptime SLA on Dedicated plan.

2) Procurement / contract talking points for your legal team:
   - Data handling: customer data is isolated in dedicated tenancy for Private deployments; hosted API offers optional prefix/KV caching controls and retention policies.
   - Security artifacts available: SOC 2 Type II (available under NDA), ISO 27001 scope summary, penetration test summary.
   - KMS: we support BYO KMS integrations; key rotation and access logs available for audit.

3) Champion enablement / internal talking tracks for Alex (product) to use with execs:
   - ROI framing: estimate---for a 1M token pilot, expected infra cost reduction vs self-hosting: ~40–60% depending on batching and quantization choices; Redwood optimize recommendations can further reduce per-token costs.
   - Risk mitigation: we provide automated fallbacks (model variants/regions) and per-route tracing to quickly rollback if quality/regressions appear.
   - Speed to value: self-service API + sample integrations can get a narrow pilot live in 2–4 weeks once procurement and security checkpoints are cleared.

4) Action items ahead of Wed call:
   - Marissa: share secure link for SOC2 Type II (done — see attachment stub in prior email).
   - Priya: send procurement questionnaire / preferred contract track.
   - Alex: confirm Victor's availability so we can invite him.

If you'd like, I can produce a one-pager tailored to FinovateBank showing estimated per-call economics and expected latency under different commit levels. Happy to follow up after the call.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior AE Lead | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com
